answer: Reaching the mesa of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. Work waits on the pearl until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the opal of the next round. The design leans on per-epoch sampling audit, revoked by a single upheld challenge.
